A claw strike (range 4, 90°): 1.0× and Slowness III for 3 s; for 8 s your next 3 melee hits deal 1.0× and Slowness III, the 3rd also freezes for 2 s; Resistance I for 8 s.
Source: The Unrivaled Tang Sect ch. 133 · Ice Empress' Pincer, Huo Yuhao's palm strike
The pincer closes; the cold does not let go.
kultivator.technique.star_anise_ice_coag: 6→18 ice spears fan out (20→32 blocks, each pierces one foe): 0.8× and Slowness II for 3 s.
Source: The Unrivaled Tang Sect ch. 467 · Star Anise Ice Coagulation, the ice-forming skill of the Star Anise Mysterious Ice Grass soul bone
Eight points of a star, eight spears of ice.
kultivator.technique.frozen_cloud_art.de: A cone of frozen cloud (12→24 blocks): 1.5×, Slowness IV for 4 s and frozen 2 s; a cloud bank (radius 4→8) lingers for 5 s with Slowness II.
kultivator.technique.frozen_cloud_art.so: Source: Against the Gods ch. 361/383 · 冰云诀 Frozen Cloud Arts of the Frozen Cloud Immortal Palace
kultivator.technique.frozen_cloud_art.lo: The cloud passes, and the world is still.
kultivator.technique.tongtian_river_free: A freezing ring spreads (8→22 blocks): frozen 4 s; then the ice breaks under them: 2.5× (×1.5 to aquatic foes, shatter) and Slowness III for 3 s.
Source: Journey to the West ch. 47–49 · the Great King of Spiritual Responses freezes the Tongtian River so the monk walks onto ice that breaks
The river freezes in an instant, and breaks just as fast.
kultivator.technique.qianlan_ice_flame.d: A deep-blue cold flame beam (24→48 blocks): 2.5×, frozen 3 s and cold 0.4×/s for 6 s; a kill bursts for 1.0× in radius 3.
kultivator.technique.qianlan_ice_flame.s: Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey · 乾蓝冰焰 Qianlan Ice Flame, which Han Li tries to refine (donghua ep. 158)
kultivator.technique.ice_snow_emperors_p: Pride of the Ice and Snow Twin Emperors

The twin emperors for 10 s: the Ice Emperor strikes a foe within 12 blocks for 0.7× every half second; the Snow Emperor's domain (radius 10→18) deals 0.4× and Slowness III every second; at the end 3.0× and frozen 3 s in radius 10→18.
Source: The Unrivaled Tang Sect · 冰雪二帝之骄傲 Pride of the Ice and Snow Twin Emperors, Huo Yuhao's 5th soul skill: an Ice Emperor + Snow Emperor fusion ice storm
Ice and snow, two emperors, one pride.
Ice spikes burst in the aimed area (radius 8→18): 2.0×, launch and rooted 1.5 s; a second later an ice mountain falls on it: 5.0× and frozen 4 s.
Source: Investiture of the Gods ch. 44/46 · 寒冰陣 of Yuan Tianjun: "上有冰山如狼牙，下有冰块如刀剑"; broken by Puxian
Above, ice like wolf fangs; below, ice like blades.
Up to three dashes (12→20 blocks) within 5 s; each afterimage bursts after 1 s for 1.5× and freezes 2 s; after the third you turn invisible for 3 s and foes within 16 blocks lose track of you.
Source: Against the Gods · 断月拂影 Broken Moon Brushing Shadow, an ice movement art that conceals the aura
The moon breaks, and the shadow is gone.
kultivator.technique.bone_chilling_flame: A ring of bone-chilling flame spreads (20→36 blocks): 3.0× and frozen 4 s; your Ice arts cost 30% less qi for 10 s.
Source: Battle Through the Heavens · 骨灵冷火 Bone Chilling Flame, Yao Lao's Heavenly Flame
Cold flame, white as old bone.
A crystal blade seeks one foe within 40 blocks: 5.0×, then shatters (radius 6→10): 3.0× (shatter) and frozen 4 s.
Source: The Unrivaled Tang Sect ch. 538 · Unparalleled Chill: a blade that shatters and releases trapped extreme cold
The blade shatters, and the cold within is freed.
kultivator.technique.frozen_end_divine_a: A frozen domain follows you (radius 24→32, 12 s): 1.5× every second and movement −95%; at the end every foe inside below 25% health is executed (bosses take 10.0× instead).
Source: Against the Gods ch. 383–385 · Frozen End Divine Art, left by Ancestor Mu Bingyun and grasped only by Xia Qingyue (really the Ice Phoenix God Investiture Canon, ch. 1277)
Where the snow stops falling, everything ends.
kultivator.technique.ice_phoenix_frost_s: A snowflake seal descends on the aimed area (radius 20→24): 4.0× and frozen 6 s; 2 s later everything struck shatters for 6.0× (shatter).
Source: Inspired by the Ice Phoenix God Investiture Canon (Against the Gods); the seal itself is game design
The phoenix seals the ground with frost.
kultivator.technique.ice_phoenix_descent: An ice phoenix for 12 s: it dives on the densest pack every 3 s (40 blocks, 4 wide): 6.0× and frozen 4 s; at the end 10.0× in radius 20→32. Meanwhile you are immune to slowness and freezing and your Ice arts deal +50%.
Source: Inspired by the Ice Phoenix soul of the Snowflower Ribbon (ch. 243) and the Ice Phoenix God Investiture Canon (Against the Gods)
Wings of ice cover the sky.
kultivator.technique.freeze_mount_qi.des: Wind and snow follow you for 20 s (radius 40): 2.0× and Slowness III every 2 s; at 10 s up to 64 foes freeze for 8 s and take 8.0×; at the end everything struck shatters for 12.0×.
kultivator.technique.freeze_mount_qi.sou: Source: Investiture of the Gods ch. 39 · Jiang Ziya calls three days of wind and snow and freezes Mount Qi, trapping the Shang army in ice
kultivator.technique.freeze_mount_qi.lor: Three days of wind and snow, and a mountain of ice.
